#!/bin/bash
set -euxo pipefail
cd /workspace
git config --global --add safe.directory /workspace
PATCH="$(dirname "$0")/patch.diff"
git apply --verbose --reject "$PATCH"

#!/bin/sh
set -eu
python3 - <<'PYCONTROL'
import ast
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/workspace/Bio/PDB/qcprot.py')
s=p.read_text()
assert s.count('        (self.rms, self.rot, _) = qcp(coords_ref, coords, self._natoms)') == 1
s=s.replace('        (self.rms, self.rot, _) = qcp(coords_ref, coords, self._natoms)','        u, singular_values, vt = np.linalg.svd(coords.T @ coords_ref)\n        correction = np.eye(3)\n        correction[-1, -1] = np.linalg.det(u @ vt)\n        self.rot = u @ correction @ vt\n        residual = coords @ self.rot - coords_ref\n        self.rms = float(np.sqrt(np.sum(residual * residual) / self._natoms))',1)
ast.parse(s)
p.write_text(s)
PYCONTROL
